key_products.title: Saw Dust (Standard & Fine)
key_products.tagline: Optimal Mesh Density for Biomass, Briquettes & Agriculture
key_products.description: Screened, dry, uniform saw dust sourced from high-grade timber. Perfect for briquettes, petroleum absorbents, cricket pitches, and mushroom cultivation.

key_products.title: Fine Wood Powder (80-120 Mesh)
key_products.tagline: Micro-milled organic filler for technical manufacturing
key_products.description: Controlled moisture wood flour engineered for Bakelite molding powders, mosquito coils, WPC decking, and electroplating finishes.

key_products.title: Dried Wood Shavings
key_products.tagline: Dust-extracted, highly absorbent natural bedding and packaging material

key_products.title: Industrial Wooden Flakes
key_products.tagline: Coarse wood flakes for board manufacturing and thermal applications
key_products.description: Uniform coarse timber flakes designed for particle board synthesis, thermal briquetting, and industrial filtration media.

mainEntity.name: What products does Kharbanda Saw Dust Store supply in bulk?

acceptedAnswer.text: We manufacture and supply high-quality Saw Dust, Fine Wood Powder, Wood Shavings, and Wooden Flakes tailored for B2B industrial usage across India.

mainEntity.name: Which industries use your wood dust and powder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our products are extensively used in Bakelite molding, mosquito coils, WPC flooring, electroplating, biomass briquettes, composites, cricket grounds, and oil spill absorption.

mainEntity.name: Where are your office and manufacturing facilities located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our main office is situated in Ashok Vihar Phase-3, Delhi (110052) and our full-scale manufacturing factory is at Industrial Estate Phase-II, Yamuna Nagar (135001, Haryana).
